shortDescription: QBE Insurance Group ASX:QBE posted a rise in nine-month premium on Friday, as Australia's largest insurer by market value benefited from strong performances across various portfolios in the Northern Hemisphere.

QBE's group premium rate — the average change in insurance premium rates across its global portfolio — was broadly flat over the period, consistent with its first-half pace
Net catastrophe claims totaled roughly $700 million for the 10 months to October, which includes an allowance of around $150 million for costs associated with the
